narrative: Diminished expectations for an October Fed rate hike dominate the weekend headlines following Powell's lack of forward guidance, setting up broad dollar softness for the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1241, positioned to test upside resistance despite a +144bp SOFR-€STR carry deficit, while GBP/USD closed Friday at 1.3328 with room to extend gains. USD/JPY settled Friday at 157.94, where heavy put skew reflects downside pressure ahead of the upcoming BoJ decision.
